description:
Take a tour of this 61.9± acre ranch for sale in Bell County, Texas, featuring a beautiful custom home, rolling terrain, abundant wildlife, and direct access to the Leon River through adjacent Corps of Engineers land. Whether you're looking for a Texas hunting ranch, a full-time country residence, or a recreational retreat, this property offers an exceptional blend of comfort and outdoor adventure.

At the heart of the ranch is a 3-bedroom, 2-bath custom Austin stone home, complemented by a 40x50 shop on a concrete slab with electricity and a rainwater collection system used for irrigation. The property's attractive elevation changes create scenic views while providing ideal habitat for whitetail deer, wild turkey, hogs, raccoons, and other native wildlife. A wildlife tax exemption is already in place, adding long-term value for the next owner.

Property Highlights

• 61.9± Acres in Bell County, Texas
• 3 Bedroom, 2 Bathroom Custom Austin Stone Home
• Access to the Leon River via Corps of Engineers Land
• Attractive Elevation Change with Scenic Views
• 40x50 Shop on a Concrete Slab with Electricity
• Rainwater Collection System for Irrigation
• Wildlife Tax Exemption in Place
• Abundant Whitetail Deer, Turkey, Hogs, and Other Native Wildlife
• Excellent Hunting and Recreational Opportunities

Whether you're searching for Bell County land for sale, Texas ranch with a home, hunting property, acreage with river access, or a country home in Central Texas, this ranch delivers a rare combination of quality improvements, privacy, and exceptional wildlife habitat.
